rows.grounds: absolutive of sam-kḷp, expressing prior determination of intent
future passive participle of vac, qualifying vartmanā
instrumental indicating the means or procedure to be followed

items.question: What prescribed method must follow the practitioner’s resolve in the ritual sequence?
premises: The practitioner first forms a resolve.
A method is yet to be stated.
That stated method serves as the means of procedure.
items.inference: After resolving, the practitioner must proceed according to the method that will be stated.
uncertainties: The specific content of the method is deferred to subsequent verses.
items.plain_english: Having made a resolve, one should proceed by the method that will now be explained.
